breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended partial top segment to the whole top boundary
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to apply the vertical traction on the full top boundary. The ground truth corrected this to apply it only on the partial top segment (0.3 <= x <= 0.5). The generated specification correctly states, 'A vertical traction of σ_yy=-10 kPa is applied to the top boundary segment where 0.3 ≤ x ≤ 0.5,' which matches the ground truth.
